cold_scope: Two fresh hash-verified executable-directory copies, each followed by warm reuse. No OS-cache eviction or physical-machine cold-start claim.

execution_budget.queue_policy: Inspect at 15 queued minutes; one replacement only after the original is confirmed completed or cancelled.

failure_policy: No per-case retry. Any failed or partial batch rejects that native series; preserve all attempts and create a separately declared replacement after diagnosis.
scope: Exact private v0.4.0-rc.6 candidate series for pinned Taskell 1.11.4. N04 now proves responsive normal-mode navigation after Escape before requesting quit. The 12-batch host matrix is freshly declared; prior v1 and v2 outcomes remain immutable.

supersedes.reason: Linux native v2 reported two N04 q-exit timeouts despite a final NORMAL screen. The revised N04 adds positive j/k navigation and screen checkpoints after Escape, proving the target resumed normal-mode input before the quit request.
